profile: Software engineer with 16 years of iOS and Android experience, including cofounding products and working at Toshl and Netcetera. Over the past three years, my personal projects have connected AI capabilities with mobile apps, backend services, agent orchestration and development automation. My strength is making these pieces work together as useful, reviewable systems.

themes.title: Agent orchestration & coordination
items: Conductor: Built a shared iOS, Android and desktop interface with a Python/FastAPI backend for managing agent instances. Explored recurring tasks, voice requests, skills and Android TV output.

Roj: Developed a swarm directory with capability matching, qualification and human review. Its four current swarms review civic website UX, produce educational people infographics, fact-check news and headlines, and track election promises against implementation evidence.

Added structured handoffs and evidence reviews in Roj, plus initial integrity reporting with temporary quarantine, audit trails and human escalation. <link href="https://roj.world" color="#176A67">roj.world</link>

themes.title: AI-assisted health research & mobile products
items: Built agents to regularly research my daughter's dermatitis, surfacing new research and promising therapies for further review.
Built a mobile app for AI-assisted health research discovery and generated audio explanations of existing diagnoses and recent research.
Made Android (Firebase App Testing) and iOS (TestFlight) betas available; designed the app to help users explore information and prepare discussions with their doctor.

themes.title: Development automation
themes.meta: Personal workflows | GitHub Actions, coding agents, Sentry integrations
items: Built scheduled research, documentation and maintenance workflows that turn findings into agent-generated repair work.
Connected Sentry alerts to coding-agent reproduction and proposed fixes; retained human pull-request review.

themes.title: Emerging user interaction
themes.meta: Ongoing interest | MCP Apps and A2UI
items: Exploring how agents could surface task-specific interfaces when needed, combining conversational workflows with dynamically generated UI. Following MCP Apps and A2UI as emerging approaches to this direction.
